operations.name: Saw Cut Blanks
operations.setup_note: Cut 7/8-inch round extrusion into individual blanks with facing allowance on both ends. Segregate and protect the short blanks from edge damage.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First Side
operations.setup_note: Hold the saw-cut blank in a collet and face the first side to establish process datum A; establish process datum B from the common thread and bore axis. Finish the bore before the final OD pass because the resulting annular wall is thin.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second Side
operations.setup_note: Locate on datum A and hold the completed bore on a short expanding mandrel, with the external thread protected from clamping. Face the reverse side to final thickness and machine the second outer-edge chamfer.

operations.name: VMC Mill – Radial Slot Pattern
operations.setup_note: Seat datum A in a thread-clearance pocket fixture and locate initially from the finished bore; clamp the outer annulus axially outside the cutter paths and remove the locating plug before cutting. Mill the four slots through the thickness into sacrificial backing without gripping the external thread.

operations.name: Deburr and Clean Machined Edges
operations.setup_note: Support the thin annulus on a protected bench fixture and remove burrs from both faces, the bore-slot intersections, chamfers, and thread ends without rounding controlled profiles.

operations.name: Pre-Anodize Dimensional Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect completed machining from process datum A and axis B before coating, including bore size, thickness, slot pattern, thread major diameter, and thread-gauge acceptance with coating compensation applied where required.

operations.name: Pre-Anodize Cleaning
operations.setup_note: Rack the machined parts and clean, degrease, activate, and rinse them for Type II anodizing. Verify a water-break-free surface before transferring the rack to masking and treatment.

operations.name: Mask External Threads
operations.setup_note: Mask the 3/4-32UN-2A external thread with a dedicated reusable cover while avoiding contamination of exposed surfaces. Leave the bore, slots, chamfers, and faces exposed under the default coating interpretation.

operations.name: Type II Class II Anodize and Seal
operations.setup_note: Process all 100 small parts as one rack batch where tank and rack capacity permit; apply olive-drab Type II Class II anodize to 5–10 micrometres and complete the specified sealing cycle. Maintain separation to prevent contact marks.

operations.name: Remove Anodize Masking
operations.setup_note: Remove the thread masks without chipping the adjacent anodize and clean any masking residue. Visually verify that coating has not breached the protected thread boundaries.

operations.name: Final Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect dimensions in the after-coating condition and verify the external thread with a 2A go/no-go ring gauge. Check anodize thickness, olive-drab color, coverage, sealing, and freedom from rack or contact defects.

clarifications.question: Is the 3/4-32UN-2A external thread required to receive the Type II anodize, or must it be masked?
clarifications.suggested_default: Mask the external thread in accordance with the standard surface-treatment rule for threaded features.

clarifications.question: Are the four R1 slots through the full 3.5 mm part thickness?
clarifications.suggested_default: Machine all four slots through the full axial thickness, consistent with extraction assumption A07.

clarifications.question: Which specific surfaces carry the parenthesized 63 microinch surface-finish requirement?
clarifications.suggested_default: Apply 125 microinch maximum to machined surfaces unless a surface is explicitly identified as requiring 63 microinch.

assumptions.text: Datum A and axis B are manufacturing process references only; the drawing defines no formal datum features.
A commercially available 22.225 mm (7/8-inch) round extrusion is used, with a 10.5 mm blank length providing facing and workholding allowance.
The four F03 slots are routed as through-slots across the full part thickness, following feature-graph assumption A07 despite the conflicting one-face wording in A06.

The external thread is masked during anodizing by default; the loose-tolerance bore and slots receive anodize, and their machining dimensions are compensated so drawing dimensions are met after coating.
The turning-template grooving step is omitted because no groove is defined and the full-length external thread terminates at free chamfered faces without a shoulder requiring thread relief.
The turning-template part-off step is omitted because individual saw-cut blanks are used rather than continuous bar-fed production.
Tailstock center drilling is omitted because the part has a very low length-to-diameter ratio; a spot drill and pilot drill are retained to start the through bore.

The milling-template face-milling, profile-milling, pocketing, drilling, reaming, tapping, countersinking, and counterboring steps are omitted because no corresponding milled features exist; its saw, deburr, and final-inspection steps are merged with the common route operations.
The surface-treatment template's complete-machining gate is represented by pre-anodize inspection, and its anodize sealing stage is represented by cure_bake as the closest controlled operation type.
